simple.summary: שַׁחַף (shachaph) means the gull (as thin) First listed occurrence: Deut 14 15.

definitions.full: H7828. shachaph [ שַׁ֫חַף ] noun [masculine] probably sea-mew, gull (compare ᵑ9 ᵐ5 ) (from attenuated body, Thes); so Post Hast. DB CUCKOW Tristr NHB 210 ff ; sterna fluviatilis , or tern Id FFP 135 M'Lean-Shipley Ency. Bib. ID .; — הַשָּׁ֑חַף Deut 14:15 = Lev 11:16 (P), in list of unclean birds.
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to peel, i.e. emaciate;
